CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[AssetTypesUserCantRead] ( @ResourceID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select Ast.ID as AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] R on (RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID and RR.ObjectType = R.[Object] and RR.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[AssetType] Ast on (Ast.[Object] = R.[Object] and Ast.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.assetid = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = Ast.ID and rasset.ruleid = r.id) where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and ( exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) )
)
